uploadMethod: Select the Automotive AAB explicitly in Play Console on the dedicated Automotive testing track.
title: Drivers Against Flock
shortDescription: Car navigation with ALPR camera awareness, route choices, and saved places.
fullDescription:
Drivers Against Flock runs directly on supported cars with Android Automotive OS. Explore the map, search for destinations, compare routes, and navigate with ALPR camera awareness and configurable avoidance settings.

Use supported voice navigation commands, view guidance and alerts, and choose map and route preferences from your car screen. Instrument-cluster maps are available when supported by your vehicle.

While parked, allow location access and set Home, Work, and favorites. Saved places and recent destinations stay on the car; they do not sync with the phone app.

An internet connection is needed for online search, map content, and route requests. This version provides the car navigation experience; mobile contribution tools, Areas, and full Scorecard history are not included.
